meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 加上 iMessage 通道：Claude 会复制并注册 iMessage 适配器、装好固定版本的依赖、构建并跑注册测试，再按你选的本地或 Photon 远程模式写配置、重启服务，并绑定你的手机号或 Apple ID。
howto.when: 当你说「add imessage」「connect imessage」「add photon」等，或要求接入 iMessage 通道时触发；本地模式要求 macOS，并给 Node 授予完全磁盘访问权限。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上 iMessage 通道
say.note: 会问你选 local 还是 remote 模式

say.text: 用 Photon 远程模式接入 iMessage
say.note: 会让你填 Photon 服务器地址和 API key

howto.what_en: Adds an iMessage channel to NanoClaw: Claude copies and registers the iMessage adapter, installs the pinned dependency, builds and tests it, writes config for local or Photon mode, restarts the service, and binds your handle.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon" etc., or when you ask to add iMessage. Local mode needs macOS plus Full Disk Access for Node.

say_en.note: Asks whether to use local or remote mode
Prompts for your Photon server URL and API key
Wires that handle as your conversation address
